metadata.description: A collection of reusable Agent Skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: exec-remote
plugins.description: Execute Python scripts on remote GPU/TPU clusters via SkyPilot

plugins.name: session-recorder
plugins.description: Records the complete session content and logs it to a daily work directory with a dynamic filename based on the active CLI agent. Use this for automated progress tracking and documentation.

plugins.name: beaver
plugins.description: Beaver project management: GitHub-native issue lifecycle with explicit /beaver-xxx commands covering the full development cycle (create, design, decompose, dev, PR, beaver-fix, tracker, focus, setup)

plugins.name: hol-guard
plugins.description: Install and operate HOL Guard local runtime security for supported AI coding agents before tool execution

plugins.name: lint-fix
plugins.description: Check and fix lint issues for changed Python files by commit, range, or working tree

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques

plugins.name: xprof-profiling-analysis
plugins.description: TPU/XLA profiling analysis: MCP tools for XProf HTTP API (operator breakdowns, memory profiles, A/B comparisons) + methodology skills for trace parsing, MFU calculation, bottleneck identification

plugins.name: gke-tpu
plugins.description: Plan and render GKE TPU Jobs and nodepool actions with explicit context/namespace safety

plugins.name: agent-recap
plugins.description: Mine local Claude/Codex session history to produce structured daily/weekly work recaps with optional GitHub Issue sync

plugins.name: tpu-perf
plugins.description: Systematic analysis of TPU pretraining efficiency. profile-anatomy: schema + reference scripts for xplane.pb / trace.json.gz. comm-analysis: per-axis NCCL bus BW, peak ICI utilization, and per-step compute/comm overlap. compute-breakdown: source-line aggregation, layer scoping, non-compute audit, v7x roofline shortfall. memory-profile: HBM peak occupancy, alive-buffer attribution, lifetime/shape/tf_op/parent_jit rollups.

plugins.name: gcloud-support-case
plugins.description: Open, list, and inspect Google Cloud support cases (Cloud TPU / GKE / GCS) via the Cloud Support API v2, with guided classification, priority confirmation, and formatted case detail output

plugins.name: service-integrations
plugins.description: Read and manage Plane, GitLab, and Outline through configured MCP tools, CLI, and APIs with credential-safe, read-first workflows

plugins.name: xprof-cli
plugins.description: Terminal-first XProf profile analysis using the official CLI, with a portable SQLite-backed XSpace protobuf fallback
